statement: For a finite N-state family of Holevo capacity C and a full-domain permutation-invariant K-receiver channel with one-receiver marginal T, there is a full-domain EB channel Psi with max_x (1/2)||T(rho_x)-Psi(rho_x)||_1 <= (N/2)*sqrt(2C/K).
assumptions: finite-dimensional input and receiver spaces
finite family of N promised input states
C is the supremum of Holevo information over priors on that family
a full-domain CPTP K-receiver extension is permutation invariant and has common marginal T
EB decoder is allowed to depend on the family and K, and is required to be one full-domain CPTP map
novelty_boundary: Brandao-Harrow Theorem 1 proves a local-measurement de Finetti estimate with sqrt(2 ln(output_dimension)/K). This candidate sharpens the final proof entropy cap to the actual I(X:B^K) for a fixed HJW label measurement, retains a reference-marginal constraint, and converts one common measurement to trace loss using a randomized Helstrom-test POVM. It is an internal adaptation, not a theorem stated in the paper, and still has an N factor.
costs: The K-receiver extension is a physical channel output; a separable Choi state, POVM and EB map are existential finite-dimensional objects. No efficient search/compiler or proof-runtime bound is established. The Helstrom setting is a witness POVM, not an extra decoder side register.
falsifier: A finite exact counterexample to the constrained local-measurement de Finetti inequality or to the Choi inversion/randomized-Helstrom conversion in the stated interface.
next_gate: Prove a dimension- and cardinality-free control of the incompatible Helstrom-test complexity using bounded Holevo information and channel-origin extendibility, or produce a qualifying counterexample to the original target.

statement: If a full-domain two-output broadcaster has worst promised-state marginal half-trace error b on an N-state family of Holevo capacity C, then for each integer t>=0 there is one full-domain EB decoder with worst-state half-trace error at most t*b + (N/2)*sqrt(2C/2^t). Consequently b*log(N)->0 and bounded C suffice for EB error to vanish.
assumptions: finite-dimensional input/output system with same receiver space at each recursion step
two-output full-domain CPTP broadcaster
finite family of N states and uniformly bounded Holevo capacity C
recursive channel use is charged: 2^t receiver leaves and 2^t-1 broadcaster invocations
novelty_boundary: Combines the finite-family candidate BIA-C2-01 with binary tree iteration and a final output permutation twirl. It is dimension-free but family-size dependent, so it does not settle arbitrary bounded-capacity experiments.
costs: For error O(b), the sufficient choice is 2^t on the order of C*N^2/b^2; the proof consumes that many physical receiver outputs and channel calls. No side register or independent-cloning guarantee is claimed.
falsifier: A finite-channel counterexample violating the recursion triangle bound, Holevo data processing, or BIA-C2-01 under its hypotheses.
next_gate: Find a complexity measure of label-conditioned discrimination that is controlled by capacity and yields a uniform EB modulus independent of N.

statement: For every fixed 0<a<1 and 0<delta<1/2, there are commuting state families of Holevo capacity at most c(a)=(1/2)[(1+a)ln(1+a)+(1-a)ln(1-a)] with at least 2^{d(1-h_2(delta))}/(d+1) elements separated in half-trace distance by at least a*delta.
assumptions: even dimension d
balanced signs s in {+1,-1}^d
states rho_s=(I+a diag(s))/d
greedy constant-weight binary code with pairwise Hamming distance at least delta*d
novelty_boundary: This shows that capacity does not bound trace-packing cardinality; all states commute and are exactly broadcastable, so it is not a counterexample to broadcasting-implies-EB reconstruction.
costs: The family lives in dimension d and has exponential cardinality in d; no implementation or acquisition advantage is asserted.
falsifier: An exact violation of the relative-entropy upper bound, balanced-code packing bound, or trace-distance calculation.
next_gate: Use this commuting family as a control when seeking a noncommutativity-sensitive complexity bound.

statement: For any full-domain permutation-invariant K-receiver channel with local output dimension d, Chiribella Theorem 5 supplies a common full-domain EB marginal within diamond distance 2*d^2/K; after iterating a two-output broadcaster with error b, this yields EB half-trace error at most t*b+d^2/2^t.
assumptions: finite-dimensional local receiver space of dimension d
full-domain symmetric broadcast channel with permutation-invariant output
iteration produces K=2^t receivers and common marginal T^t
novelty_boundary: The bound is a cited finite de Finetti theorem for arbitrary permutation-invariant output. The Bose-supported d/K theorem is not used; permutation twirling does not imply Bose support.
costs: The K-receiver channel is a physical extension. The common measure-and-prepare approximation is existential; no postselection or success probability occurs. It gives a sufficient condition b*log(d)->0, not a capacity-only theorem.
falsifier: A contradiction to Chiribella Theorem 5 or a mismatch between its diamond-norm normalization and the stated half-trace marginal consequence.
next_gate: Seek a new capacity-sensitive extension bound that improves the local dimension d^2 without assuming Bose-symmetric support.

statement: The general implication from uniformly bounded Holevo capacity and vanishing two-receiver broadcast error to uniform EB reconstruction remains unresolved by this cycle; no qualifying counterexample was constructed.
assumptions: family dimension and cardinality may grow
full-domain CPTP broadcaster with each promised-state marginal error tending to zero
uniform Holevo capacity bound
one full-domain EB decoder must work uniformly on the whole family
novelty_boundary: Finite-family and dimension-dependent sufficient conditions are established as above, but neither controls all growing-dimension, growing-cardinality bounded-capacity families. N61 has divergent capacity; N93's bounded-capacity controls do not have vanishing broadcast error.
costs: Any resolution must charge the full broadcaster output, all physical receiver systems, and a single common EB decoder; no label-dependent side register is allowed.
falsifier: A proof uniform in both dimension and family cardinality, or an explicit sequence satisfying bounded capacity, vanishing broadcast error, and a positive global EB lower bound.
next_gate: Derive an incompatibility-sensitive information bound eliminating the N factor, or construct a channel-origin symmetric counterexample with all stated costs visible.
